record_scope_reconstruction: Two reported election-closure sites: Aflao with Ghana and Hilacondji with Benin. The observed April 30 resumption binds these sites only.

source_checks.finding: Original report separately describes resumed entries, exits and commerce at Aflao and the same observation at Hilacondji on April 30.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Two reported election-closure sites: Aflao with Ghana and Hilacondji with Benin. The observed April 30 resumption binds these sites only. Current phase only: Election-related land restriction as reported at Aflao and Hilacondji, to observed 30 April resumption.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: A May publication date is not the reopening date. The national order is broader than the observed endpoints; identical implementation at every land post is not established. Reopening republications are not independent observations.
